_comment: Ceilings for everything a session loads BEFORE it does any work, in tokens
(rough: words x 1.3, tools/build_views.py:_approx_tokens). One registry so
no cap is declared twice -- registry-source-of-truth. Practice:
A ceiling is a watermark, not an endorsement: each was set at the measured
size when the surface was last reviewed, rounded up for headroom, so it can
be ratcheted DOWN by a reduction pass and never drifts up unnoticed. Raising
one is a decision somebody makes on purpose, in a commit, with the reason in
'why'. Never raise it to make a red check green.

AGENTS.md.why: Set at 19000 against a tree 14 commits stale, then re-measured on the merged tree at 19687 -- the growth is one freshness-guard gotcha added upstream the same day. Raised once, after the review the rule asks for rather than instead of it: the gotchas section is 10,494 of the total, and every entry very_deep_check.py flagged as claiming its own trap settled was read and still bites, so nothing was archived. The next raise should come with a reduction pass, not another re-measurement. 2026-09-11, later the same day: adding generated-edit-goes-upstream put the file at 20,048 and the ceiling was NOT raised. The reduction pass the clause asks for found one entry whose central claim had gone false -- the timezone-diagnosis entry called settings.local.json's env block inert, which the commit-identity entry beside it contradicts from a same-day measurement -- and moved it to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 31 in full. Measured 19,922 after. 2026-09-11, later still: the clean-session practice took the file to 20,235 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. The reduction pass compressed the verify_harness fixture-credential entry -- three variables, all three now scrubbed at the head of the harness and held there by a control, so only a NEW variable can bite -- to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 32 in full, keeping the symptom, the way to tell inheritance from absence, and the generalization live. Measured 19,753 after. 2026-09-13: spawn-session's wake-first amendment took the file over at 20,124 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. Two reductions, in order: the new paragraph itself was cut to its claim, dropping the origin story that the practice's own Story already holds in full; then the git-clone-without---branch gotcha was compressed to the symptom, the lesson and the pin. That one was already archived as record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 36, whose own verdict says the live entry should keep the incident short and the lesson in full -- it had never actually been shortened, so this pass did what the archive already claimed. Measured 19,986 after. 2026-09-13, later: one quick-index row for spec/SOURCE_SET_PROSE_GAP.md took the file to 20,040 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. The reduction pass compressed the declared-hooks-exist gotcha -- its wrong-inference symptom kept, its story dropped to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 37, where it already sat in full -- on the ground that BOTH halves are mechanical now, so a session meets this as a failing check rather than as a reading it has to get right unaided. Measured 19935 after. 2026-09-13, a reduction pass run against the whole always-loaded surface rather than against one added practice: measured 19,986 here, plus 2,863 of .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md and 55 of CLAUDE.md, for 22,904 tokens before any work starts against a hard target of 20,000. Three duplications came out, each verified present in full somewhere a session already reads: the eight Precedent commands' coining stories (729 tokens -- every one of them is in its own practice file's ## Story, which the standing instruction and the occasion index both route to), three convention bullets restating reply-links-files, doc-references-are-links and volatile-rules-carry-dates (174 -- the first is in the resident block verbatim, the other two in the occasion index), and the duplicated halves of the private-source bootstrap block (93). The environment-naming trap in the credential gotcha moved to INSTALL.md section 8's environment table, where somebody setting the variables reads it (100). Measured 18,890 after, so the ceiling is ratcheted DOWN from 20,000 to 19,000 rather than left as headroom. What this pass did NOT do: the gotchas section is 8,963 of the 18,890 across 36 entries, tools/very_deep_check.py's currency pass flags none of them as stale, and 26 of the 36 were already shortened by an earlier pass that decided what the live half should keep -- so cutting further there is a judgment call and went to Morgan costed rather than being taken here. Re-measured 18,868 after merging both: this pass and the declared-hooks-exist compression above landed in the same hour, on top of a quick-index row and go-merge's new blocked-step-hands-off clause, which the resident command list carries too. 2026-09-13, later still: a ninth command (`vocabulary`), the `Approved` trigger on go-merge and the seeded merge authorization on spawn-session arrived on top of that ratchet -- about 270 tokens against 132 of headroom -- and the 19,000 ceiling was NOT raised back. The reduction came out of the same command list the pass above had just written: every new clause was cut to its rule, and four glosses that restate their own practice's Why rather than its Rule went with them (three-things' attention-rather-than-action reasoning, park-it's explanation of why no explanation is owed, spawn-session's answer-back argument, my-options' contrast with Plain words). A quick-index row for the vocabulary tool was dropped as duplicating the command list's own entry. Measured 18,994 after. 2026-09-13, the split: Morgan chose 'bolded lead only' from a costed menu, so the gotchas section became an INDEX -- one line per trap, the symptom and a link -- and all 36 entries moved to record/GOTCHAS.md in full. Verified word for word: 6,778 words out of the section, 6,778 into the record, identical. 8,858 tokens of section became 1,462 of index. Measured 11,468 after merging the base branch back in (which had added a ninth command meanwhile), with .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md at 2,863 and CLAUDE.md at 55: 14,386 before any work starts, against the 20,000 target. Ceiling ratcheted 19,000 -> 12,000. The guarantee moved with the text rather than being dropped: precedent_check.py's environment-gotchas follows the links and applies the same story test to the record (five stated cases in verify_harness.py), and very_deep_check.py's currency pass reads the record's bodies, so it still sees 36 entries and 9,473 tokens rather than going quietly blind on one-line symptoms.

CLAUDE.md.why: An @AGENTS.md include. Anything more than a line or two here is content that belongs in the file it includes.

.precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md.why: Generated at session start from the team and individual sources, so it varies with what resolved; the ceiling is the whole of what those sources may add to every session here.
